shortDescription: MPESB Stenographer and Assistant Sub Inspector ASI Recruitment 2026 notification released. Check the official PDF for vacancies, eligibility, dates and application instructions.
content:
Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has released the recruitment notification for Stenographer and Assistant Sub Inspector (ASI) posts 2026.

Candidates should download and read the official notification for post-wise vacancies, educational qualification, age limit, application dates, fee, selection process and examination instructions.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date: 17/09/2026
  • Application Begin: As per notification
  • Last Date for Apply Online: As per notification
  • Exam Date: As per schedule

Important Instructions

  • Verify eligibility and post-wise requirements before applying.
  • Keep scanned photograph, signature and identity documents ready.
  • Save the submitted application form and payment receipt.
